title: Coronation of Shivaji as Chhatrapati
summary: In 1674 Shivaji held his own coronation as chhatrapati at Raigad, his capital, with pandits led by Varanasi's Gaga Bhatt consecrating him. Encyclopedia.com says he proclaimed a new era, the Raj Shaka, and issued a gold coin, the Shivarai hon. EBSCO adds that the coronation did not confirm him as ruler of all Maharashtra.

importance.justification: Encyclopedia.com presents the coronation as the point where Shivaji proclaimed a new era and issued his own coinage.

sources.title: Wikidata item Q3626515 (Raigad Fort), coordinate location (P625)

reviewer_note: Accounts differ in detail: EBSCO describes a traditional Hindu coronation with some eleven thousand Brahmans and renders chhatrapati as lord of the universe; Encyclopedia.com renders it lord of the umbrella. Those details are attributed in sources, not asserted in the summary. EBSCO does not name Raigad (it names Rajgarh as his capital at death); Encyclopedia.com names Raigad. No day appears on the opened pages, so only the year is recorded. Wider assessments of Shivaji differ and are not characterised.
